run_gen_build_yaml: run the python script to generate YAML build configuration for gRPC naming resolver tests
build_resolver_test_cases: build resolver test case dictionaries from YAML resolver component test record groups data
append_zone_name: append a DNS zone name suffix to a given record name for resolver test targets
build_expected_addrs_cmd_arg: build a semicolon-separated command argument string from a list of expected address dictionaries
generate_grpc_naming_build_yaml: generate the complete build YAML with resolver test targets and address sorting test targets
